name: PraxelOps
description: AI-powered infrastructure operations platform with a premium macOS-inspired desktop and web interface

modules.name: macOS Studio Desktop Shell
modules.notes: Shell, menu bar, sidebar, traffic lights, command palette, theming and the M6.3 login screen are implemented. No browser-level UI tests; login UI not browser-tested (see PROJECT_STATUS.md 7.6).

modules.name: SSH Connection & Terminal Multiplexer
modules.notes: Implemented: ssh2 adapter (exec, PTY), authenticated WebSocket terminal gateway (single-use file-backed tickets, Origin checks, session caps, pre-auth limits), TOFU known-hosts (fail-closed on corrupt store), two-process production E2E. Limitations: no external-host validation (blocked), TOFU enrollment is automatic, Windows-only evidence. See PROJECT_STATUS.md 7.6.

modules.name: SFTP Remote File Browser
modules.notes: Read-only browsing and file preview exist (SSHAdapter.listSFTPDirectory/readSFTPFile in src/lib/ssh/adapter.ts, /api/sftp, src/components/sftp). No src/lib/sftp module, no upload/download queue. Verified only against the in-process ssh2 fixture.

modules.name: Server Inventory & Live Telemetry
modules.notes: Server inventory (CRUD, UI, credentials stripped from responses) exists. No live telemetry collector or poller exists and src/lib/telemetry is absent; metrics are shown as unpolled unless present (only the explicit demo loader sets them).

modules.name: AI Diagnostics & Guarded Command Generator
modules.notes: Rule-based diagnostics, typed operation policy and HMAC-signed, single-use, expiring proposals with an explicit approval route exist (src/lib/ai). No LLM provider adapter.

modules.name: Deployment Workflows & Log Streaming
modules.notes: Runner executes workflow steps over SSH with per-step output capture, a rollback command, an API route and UI (src/lib/deployments/runner.ts, /api/deployments). No dedicated tests in the suite, no live log streaming.

modules.name: Security Verification & Audit Trail
modules.notes: Implemented in src/lib/security and src/lib/storage: operator login (scrypt), cookie sessions, CSRF and exact Origin/Host allowlists, ticket service, rate limiting, secret redaction, atomic locked JSON stores, audit events. Limitations: audit log is a locked JSON array without a hash chain, credentials are plaintext at rest, sessions are in memory. See PROJECT_STATUS.md 7.6.
